scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind computer generations and devices.
Vacuum tube: was used in many first-generation computers. Transistor: replaced vacuum tubes in many later machines.
Integrated circuit: combined electronic parts on a chip. Microprocessor: puts processing circuitry onto a chip. Personal computer: is designed for use by an individual.
In a small group, draw or safely examine pictures of vacuum tube, transistor and integrated circuit. Explain one real-life use for each in Ghana.
